title: chore(deps): align @objectstack/formula|lint|client to ^15.1.1 (spec skew)
body:
Related: #2661 · framework#3183 / framework#3205.

## What

`@objectstack/formula` (core, app-shell), `@objectstack/lint` (app-shell), and `@objectstack/client` (data-objectstack, console) were still pinned to `^14.6.0` while `@objectstack/spec` was already `^15.1.1` — a leftover skew from the v15 upgrade. This aligns all four pins to `^15.1.1`.

## Why it's safe

- The framework publishes these packages in **lockstep** with spec; formula/lint/client's own `15.0.0` CHANGELOG entries are pure dependency bumps (no API breaks) — verified against the framework repo.
- **A/B checked**: `data-objectstack`'s pre-existing `type-check` errors (fetch-mock tuple typings in `exportDownload.test.ts`) reproduce identically on client `^14.6.0` — unrelated to this bump.

## Why it matters

`packages/core/src/evaluator/fieldRules.ts` delegates `visibleWhen`/`readonlyWhen`/`requiredWhen` to `@objectstack/formula`'s `ExpressionEngine` — the canonical CEL engine. With the caret on `^15.1.1`, the client picks up the framework's **`dateField == today()` equality fix** (framework#3205, AST temporal-comparison rewrite) automatically at the next 15.x release, keeping client UX verdicts identical to server enforcement.

Renderer/action `visible`/`disabled` predicates are **not** affected either way — they run through the home-grown JS `ExpressionEvaluator`, which is the separate architectural gap tracked in **#2661**.

## Verification

- `@object-ui/core`: full suite **89 green**, `type-check` clean.
- Targeted formula-adjacent tests from root (`celAuthoring.test.ts` — runs against the **real** 15.1.1 engine — `clientValidation.fieldRules.test.ts`, all of `core/src/evaluator`): **308 green**.
- `data-objectstack`: tests green; type-check failures proven pre-existing (A/B on client 14).
- Resolved versions confirmed in `node_modules`: formula/lint/client all `15.1.1`.
- Changeset: patch for core / app-shell / data-objectstack / console.
